angle: Other CRMs ask you to import on faith; here the mapping screen and the summary are computed and never saved, and the preview runs the very same planner the commit runs, so the counts you read are the rows you get.

hook.question: What if preview was the import?

scenes.vo: EstateCRM reads the bytes of your Excel or CSV file, not its name.
scenes.focus: the file chooser on the upload step

scenes.vo: Columns are matched by header text, and a Meta lead ads file is named.
scenes.focus: the line saying this looks like a Meta lead ads export

chip.title: Matched by header
chip.sub: Meta lead ads named on screen

scenes.vo: Change any guess yourself, and the numbers recompute before a single row is saved.

chip.title: Every guess is yours
chip.sub: Remap any column, nothing saved yet

scenes.vo: The preview runs the same code the import runs, so these counts hold.
scenes.focus: the row counts under What will happen

chip.title: Same planner, same counts
chip.sub: Not a sample, not an estimate

scenes.vo: Nothing reaches your CRM until you press the button, and then it matches.
scenes.focus: the new leads sitting in the table

chip.title: You press, then it writes
chip.sub: The count you read is the count you get

cta.note: Excel or CSV. Nothing writes until you do.
